meta.transport: Vercel AI Gateway, AI SDK 7.0.107, concurrency 10

claims.measured: Boolean ECE 0.048 — level with Sol (0.043) and Terra (0.051), better than Luna (0.105). Multiple-choice ECE 0.124: overconfident, same as Sol.
claims.measured_zh: 是/否题 ECE 0.048，与 Sol（0.043）、Terra（0.051）同级，好于 Luna（0.105）。多选题 ECE 0.124，过度自信，与 Sol 相当。

claims.claim_zh: 相似输入给出相近输出
claims.measured: 60 rephrased questions: zero answer flips (Sol 1, Terra 3, Luna 9). 120 polarity pairs: 1 self-contradiction (Sol 5, Terra 6, Luna 11). Best of the five.
claims.measured_zh: 60 道换问法：0 次翻转（Sol 1、Terra 3、Luna 9）。120 组正反问法：仅 1 组自相矛盾（Sol 5、Terra 6、Luna 11）。五个模型中最稳。

claims.claim: Deterministic — use it like a strongly typed object
claims.claim_zh: 输出确定，可当强类型对象直接调用
claims.measured: Same question 5×: no answer ever flipped, max probability drift 0.09. But only 12 of 30 were bit-identical. Terra and Luna flipped outright (drift 0.81, 0.98).
claims.measured_zh: 同题重复 5 次：判断从未翻转，概率最大差 0.09。但仅 12/30 完全一致。Terra、Luna 会把同题答反（最大差 0.81、0.98）。

claims.claim: Under 100 ms — fits inside a 60 FPS game loop
claims.claim_zh: 延迟 0.1 秒以内，能放进 60 FPS 游戏循环
claims.measured: Server-side median 248 ms, fastest single call 189 ms. Across 40 sequential calls, not one came in under 100 ms. End-to-end median 456 ms.
claims.measured_zh: 服务端中位 248ms，最快 189ms。40 次顺序调用无一低于 100ms。全程中位 456ms。

claims.claim_zh: 比语言模型快 100 倍 / 194 倍
claims.measured: One question per call: ~3–3.6× faster than GPT-5.6 (456 ms vs 1.3–1.7 s), ~2× vs GPT-4.1-mini. Batching 50 questions into one call gets to ~5 ms per question — that is where the order of magnitude lives.
claims.measured_zh: 单题调用：比 GPT-5.6 快约 3–3.6 倍（456ms 对 1.3–1.7 秒），比 GPT-4.1-mini 快约 2 倍。一次打包 50 题时摊到每题约 5ms，数量级差距只在这里成立。

claims.claim: $42 per billion input tokens, output free
claims.claim_zh: 输入每 10 亿 token 42 美元，输出免费
claims.measured: 1,154,813 input tokens billed at $0.0485 — rate confirmed. Note Jev counts roughly 2× the tokens GPT does for the same text.
claims.measured_zh: 1,154,813 输入 token 计费 $0.0485，费率一致。注意同样内容 Jev 计入的 token 约为 GPT 的 2 倍。

claims.claim_zh: 比语言模型便宜 445 倍
claims.measured: Same 2,390 questions: 88× cheaper than Sol, 45× than Terra, about 5× than Luna and GPT-4.1-mini. 445× did not reproduce against anything we ran.
claims.measured_zh: 同样 2390 题：比 Sol 便宜 88 倍，比 Terra 45 倍，比 Luna 和 GPT-4.1-mini 约 5 倍。445 倍未复现。

claims.measured: 36 answers were wrong while ≥90% confident, out of 1,200 standard-dataset questions. That is the fewest of five models (Sol 84, Terra 88, Luna 140, GPT-4.1-mini 142) — but it is not zero.
claims.measured_zh: 1200 道标准数据集题中，36 次「信心 ≥90% 却答错」。是五个模型里最少的（Sol 84、Terra 88、Luna 140、GPT-4.1-mini 142），但不是零。

claims.measured: Same 150 XNLI items: 79.3% in English, 68.7% in Chinese. All three GPT-5.6 variants dropped further (13–16 points) than Jev did (11).
claims.measured_zh: 同一批 150 道 XNLI：英文 79.3%，中文 68.7%。GPT-5.6 三个版本掉得更多（13–16 点），Jev 降幅（11 点）反而更小。
claims.verdict: True, and not unique to Jev
claims.verdict_zh: 属实，但非 Jev 独有
